en: The postcard displays a seaside open-air café with colorful chairs and tables. The prominent feature is a classical white colonnade with circular entablature and distinctive art-deco style lamps. People are lounging and enjoying the sunny weather. The background reveals a clear view of the sea. The reverse side provides text in several languages including Bulgarian and details about the location and venue.
